nodes.name: Forward To Ingestion
nodes.notes: neverError keeps a 413/429/503 on the happy path so it reaches Slack as a readable message instead of a red execution.

nodes.name: Notify #data-feeds
nodes.notes: Slack incoming-webhook URL comes from the SLACK_DATA_FEEDS_WEBHOOK env var, never from a stored credential, so this JSON stays safe to commit.

meta.description: Phase J workflow #1. Daystar drop -> filename gate -> FastAPI /api/ingest/indicators -> Slack #data-feeds. Idempotency is delegated to the ingestion service's SHA-256 payload dedupe; this workflow reports the duplicate rather than tracking its own.
